reason: Provides desktop screenshot capture through browser hotkeys and an optional agent-facing image-reading tool, with PNG output saved locally.

summaries.zh: 通过浏览器快捷键捕获选区或整个虚拟桌面，并将 PNG 截图保存到本地供用户或智能体使用。
summaries.en: Captures a selected region or the full virtual desktop through browser hotkeys and saves PNG screenshots locally for users or agents.

capabilities: Captures selected regions or the full virtual desktop screen
Saves screenshots as PNG files in the user Downloads directory
Provides an agent-facing screenshot and optional image-reading tool through the modlens CLI
Adds browser hotkeys and inserts screenshot paths into the input field
